basic_info.description: Year-End Promotional Pricing, HOA & CC incentives available for a limited time. Residence 221 is available for immediate move-in. Yerba Buena Island is San Francisco's newest and most exciting new neighborhood. This incredible home features a generously sized floor plan w/ two-bed, 2.5 baths w/ 9' ceiling & floor to ceiling windows. Kitchen appointments include Arclinea Italian cabinetry & Miele appliances, Dornbracht faucets & wine fridge. The home offers white oak flooring throughout. Thoughtfully designed primary bathrooms with spa-styling including Carrara marble counters, generous soaking tub and separate shower w/ Carrara marble surrounds . Additional powder room, recessed lighting with dimmers, full size vented washer/dryer. The home features views of the tranquil European styled courtyard gardens. Residents will have access to unprecedented amenities, including The Island Club, a ~10,000 SF Aidlin Darling Designed clubhouse with fitness studio & wellness programming, outdoor pool, spa & fireplace, private dining room; staffed front
